newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise on festival demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise on festival demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices gained on Wednesday on increased consumer buying and festival interest while supplies remained low, dealers said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 moved up by 15/20 rupees to 1,285/1,310 rupees while M-30 rose by 5/15 to 1,315/1,355 rupees. Sugar mill delivery also climbed up by 10 rupees to 1,225/1,245 rupees.
Overall market sentiment was firm at the close but some traders said they expected higher prices to attract profit taking in the next few days.
